release.content: pubkit 0.15.2 was released on 2026-10-29 from commit d2f0ebfb70552d5c584e7747bf1ce9a930e3ae8c with these changes.

rows: The CI pubkit sync writes passes SONAR_TOKEN to pubkit's sonar and functional jobs by name instead of secrets: inherit, which GitHub drops without a word when the repository and pubkit have different owners, so a repository moved to another organization lost its SonarQube Cloud analysis while CI stayed green. Every sonar job now warns, rather than notes, when no token arrived on a run that is not a pull request from a fork, naming that cause
